text:
jen: Heads-up — Acme asked us to onboard Kiwi-7B (open checkpoint) and get a quantized 4-bit variant on Dedicated for latency testing. They flagged throughput needs ~120 qps and want an initial quality smoke before next Tuesday. Can eng-ml pick this up?

marta: tagging @vikram and @oliver. any known quirks with this repo?

vikram: I pulled the checkpoint last night. model uses grouped attention + rotary; should be compatible with our quant flow but we need to confirm tokenizer id mapping. quick check: sample decoding looks ok unquantized.

oliver: for 4-bit we should try PTQ (LLM.int8 -> custom 4-bit) and run the usual eval set. also want klue-style instruction tests and our privacy prompts.

jen: priority = medium (customer POC), deadline soft = Tue. allocate one ML eng + one quant.

marta: I'll take lead on onboarding. @oliver can you run the first quant sweep?

oliver: yes. I'll start with qtype=nf4, group=128. quick config I'm planning: ```
quant_mode: static
qtype: nf4
group_size: 128
calib_samples: 256
```

oliver: question — do we prefer per-channel or per-tensor for this weight layout? my guess: per-channel for feedforward, per-tensor for attention.

vikram: agree. per-channel for large matmuls reduces avg error. also set clip thresholds during calibration.

marta: noted. I need a Dedicated instance recommendation for 120 qps — @tom any recs?

tom: for 7B quant on A100-ish hardware, aim for 4x-card pool to hit consistent 120 qps with batching 8-16. if they want single-tenant Dedicated, recommend reserved 4xA100-nv24.

eval-bot: smoke run started (id: kiwi-smoke-176543). expected finish ~10m. metrics tracked: PPL, Rouge-L on instruction-set, toxicity quickcheck.

jen: please post smoke summary here when ready. also include any regression examples (bad completions) so PM can review.

oliver: starting calibration now. will post logs + small diff against fp16 baseline.

marta: I'll add onboarding checklist items: model card, license verification, tokenizer mapping, sample prompt set, eval harness link, infra request (Dedicated sizing), alerting hooks.

vikram: one more ask — check KV cache compatibility after quant (some layouts break past hidden size 8192). add a long-seq generation test.

marta: good call. I'll include a 4k token generation smoke.

oliver: calib done. early numbers vs fp16: PPL +2.1%, latency down ~48% token-wise. pushing full smoke now.

eval-bot: smoke run complete. summary: PPL delta +2.3%, Rouge-L delta -1.8 points on our instruction set. 3/200 prompts flagged as truncated/odd. details: https://internal-evals/runs/kiwi-smoke-176543

marta: can you paste one of the bad examples (anonymized)?

oliver: bad example (anonymized):
```
Prompt: "Summarize the policy for data retention."
FP16: "Our policy retains logs for 90 days, ..."
4-bit: "Our policy retains logs for 9..."  // truncated/confused numeral
```

marta: hmm looks like tokenization/decoding edge-case. @vikram can you reproduce with different tokenizer?

vikram: reproduced. it's a tokenizer id shift for one punctuation cluster — I think the checkpoint's tokenizer.json uses legacy merges. I'll run a remap and retest.

jen: good catch. keep me posted — if fix is small, we can move to canary.

oliver: retested with remapped tokenizer: bad examples went to 0/200, PPL delta now +1.1%, Rouge-L delta -0.6. latency similar.

marta: solid. next steps: create onboarding ticket with artifacts (model card, quant config, smoke link, infra request) and schedule canary on Dedicated next week. assigning to @marta and @oliver. :thumbsup:

jen: thanks team. I'll inform Acme of timeline and flag canary window.

tom: I'll pre-provision a 4x-card Dedicated pool in staging for the canary.

oliver: leaving run artifacts at: s3://redwood-onboard/kiwi/176543/ -- includes calib checkpoints, eval diffs, and config.

marta: closing triage here. ping me if you need anything else.

jen: awesome — appreciate the quick turnaround. :sparkles:
